description: This Java source file defines a JSF managed bean controller class 'TodoListController' for managing a to-do list application. It includes methods for CRUD operations, UI event handling, and integrates with a DAO and models.

classes.name: TodoListController
classes.description: A JSF managed bean for controlling the to-do list UI, providing CRUD operations, selection handling, and integration with the data layer.

methods.name: getTodoItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of to-do items from the DAO.

methods.name: buttonUpdateAction
methods.description: Marks selected to-do items as complete, with null checks and user feedback.

methods.name: buttonAddAction
methods.description: Creates a new to-do item with current input and resets input fields.

methods.name: setSelectedItem
methods.description: Sets the currently selected to-do item.

methods.name: getSelectedItem
methods.description: Returns the currently selected to-do item.

methods.name: setSelectedItems
methods.description: Sets the list of selected to-do items.

methods.name: getSelectedItems
methods.description: Returns the list of selected to-do items.

methods.name: onRowSelect
methods.description: Handles row selection event in PrimeFaces, with null safety.

methods.name: onRowUnselect
methods.description: Handles row unselection event in PrimeFaces, with null safety.
